description:
Our soft-tail frame isn’t just strong—it’s built to handle whatever the trail throws at you. Whether you’re crushing mountain singletracks, weaving through forest paths, or commuting on city streets, it delivers unbeatable stability and shock absorption to keep you fresh, even on all-day rides. Say goodbye to that post-ride fatigue.

Tackle rough terrain like a pro with our full suspension system. It soaks up bumps and rocks, giving you better grip on descents and sharper control when you need it most—all while keeping the ride comfortable enough for casual cruises. No more jarring rides, just pure confidence.

18-Speed Drivetrain: Shift Seamlessly, Ride Smarter

Precision 18-speed gearing lets you dial in the perfect cadence, whether you’re climbing steep hills, bombing down slopes, or picking up speed on flat ground. Beginners love the easy, smooth shifts; seasoned riders appreciate the performance. It’s the sweet spot between power, comfort, and value.

Lightweight, responsive, and easy to maintain—our V-brakes deliver consistent stopping force when you hit the levers. Mud, rain, or dry conditions? They’ve got your back. Simple to adjust, so you spend less time fixing and more time riding.

Fits Most Riders, Ready to Roll Fast

With a 17-inch frame, this bike works for riders 5’2” to 6’2”—no more guessing if it’ll fit. And setup? A breeze. It comes 85% pre-assembled, with all tools included, so you can get from box to trail (or street) in no time.​

Master any trail with the Hiland Boulder Mountain Bike. Featuring a high-performance suspension fork, 21-speed drivetrain, and dual disc brakes for ultimate control. Shop now!
